title: Home practical guide and safety card: sound meter
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 20 (Home practical guide and safety card: sound meter (portal worksheet; adult sets up the app, never close to ears))
intro: Lesson 20: Measuring volume: decibels and our ears. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To measure the volume of everyday sounds in decibels
equipment: A phone with a sound meter app (adult sets it up)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult opens the sound meter app
Hold the phone at arm's length, never close to ears
Measure a quiet room for 10 seconds and record the reading
Measure talking, a tap running and a kettle (from a safe distance)
Record the highest reading for each
Order the sounds from quietest to loudest

questions.q: Big question: how could you prove which room is noisiest?
questions.a: Measure each room in decibels at the same distance and time.
